name: Maeda Kosen Co., Ltd.
summary: Maeda Kosen Co., Ltd. engages in the social infrastructure and industrial infrastructure business in Japan and internationally. It manufactures and sale civil engineering, construction, agricultural, and industrial materials; nonwoven fabrics; and light alloy forged wheels for automobiles.
